video_title: Lakers vs Suns | Postgame Interviews x Highlights: November 15, 2026

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on Lakers' fourth-quarter defensive struggles and effort
quotes.excerpt: We're working too hard and we're playing too hard to build these leads. It's a disservice to each other.
quotes.quote: I told the team this after the game. We're working too hard and we're playing too hard to build these leads. It's a disservice to each other to take your foot off the gas. Defensively, we did a lot of really good things through three quarters. Going into the fourth, we had a 107 defensive rating and then we had a 165 defensive rating in the fourth. Some of that, a lot of it, started at the beginning of the fourth. We had two possessions where they're walking it up and we don't even talk and get matched up and they hit wide-open threes and all of a sudden they get going. You can't allow that. You have to play for 48 minutes and we're going to need our defense to win us games.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on the Lakers defensive lapses in the fourth quarter: We had a 107 defensive rating through three quarters and a 165 in the fourth. You cannot allow that. You have to play for 48 minutes.

structured.context: JJ Redick discusses the team's defensive struggles in the fourth quarter after allowing a high defensive rating.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick praises the Suns' second unit performance
quotes.excerpt: Their second unit is their best unit right now. That group with Gillespie and Connard and Goody and Dunn.
quotes.quote: The other thing is their second unit. We watch these guys all season. Their second unit is their best unit right now. That group with Gillespie and Connard and Goody and Dunn, that's been their best unit this season. I don't even know what the numbers say, I'm just saying from watching it, that unit plays like the unit that played last year. Their team played last year and they're tough to guard. They move, they cut, they can all shoot. It's a hard unit to guard, but we just have to be better with our attention to detail and our effort.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on the Suns second unit: That group with Gillespie and Connard and Goody and Dunn has been their best unit this season. They move and they cut and they can all shoot. It is a hard unit to guard.

structured.context: JJ Redick praises the performance and toughness of the Phoenix Suns' second unit.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on Quinton Grimes' rhythm and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: He's a really underrated playmaker when he's in the paint and he did that again tonight for us.
quotes.quote: Quinton Grimes was awesome. Just found a rhythm throughout the game, hit a number of big shots, probably none bigger than the call bank from the top of the key. But I thought he did a great job of touching the paint and he's been consistent throughout the year. When he touches the paint, he's generally making the right read, whether to score or get an assist. I think he's a really underrated playmaker when he's in the paint and he did that again tonight for us.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on Quentin Grimes: I think he is a really underrated playmaker when he is in the paint. He did a great job of touching the paint and making the right read whether to score or get an assist.

structured.context: JJ Redick praises Quentin Grimes for his playmaking and rhythm during the game.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on Quinton Grimes' aggression and consistency
quotes.excerpt: He's consistently tried to start with a level of aggression scoring the basketball and that sets the table.
quotes.quote: He's always done that. I feel like he's consistently tried to start with a level of aggression scoring the basketball and that sets the table for us eventually playing four-on-three. That's what happened throughout the game, particularly late. They're firing him, and I thought he did a great job. The pick-and-roll coverage they were running was a little bit of up-to-touch with a soft blitz, so they kind of kept the big on it. I thought he did a great job of dragging that out and then creating two-on-one opportunities on the backside. He ended up with nine assists, but it's one of those games where, yeah, he scored a lot, but he also just generated a lot of really good offense for us.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on the Lakers offensive strategy: Quentin Grimes did a great job of dragging out the pick and roll coverage and creating two on one opportunities on the backside. He generated a lot of really good offense for us.

structured.context: JJ Redick explains how Quentin Grimes' aggression helps create offensive opportunities for the team.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on Quinton Grimes' work ethic and routine
quotes.excerpt: Whether you're shooting well or you're shooting poorly, you should just keep the same routine.
quotes.quote: With Quinton Grimes, watching him every day, when he is in the gym, he's very consistent with his routine. We tell players this all the time: whether you're shooting well or you're shooting poorly, you should just keep the same routine. Because otherwise, then it becomes is shooting a superstitious thing? I don't think it is. Shooting is based on form and reps and confidence and the only way to build that confidence is through the reps. So I think he's handled it really well. He's been in the gym, he's gotten his shots up, he's done his routine, and he's a high 30s guy.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on shooting slumps: Shooting is based on form and reps and confidence. The only way to build that confidence is through the reps. I tell players whether you are shooting well or poorly you should keep the same routine.

structured.context: JJ Redick discusses the importance of consistency and routine for Quentin Grimes' shooting performance.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on team standards and avoiding a ceiling
quotes.excerpt: I don't want these guys to put a ceiling on themselves. I don't think we should put a ceiling.
quotes.quote: Part of that is because I don't want these guys to put a ceiling on themselves. I don't think we should put a ceiling on this group. This group is committed to getting better every single day, recognizing that this is a process to become a high-level team. That's what I want from this group is hold each other to that standard every single time. And that's honestly, that's the frustrating part at times because you see how good we can be.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick on the Lakers potential: I do not want these guys to put a ceiling on themselves. This group is committed to getting better every single day and recognizing that this is a process to become a high level team.

structured.context: JJ Redick emphasizes the need for the team to maintain high standards and avoid self-imposed limitations.

quotes.speaker: Jake LaRavia
quotes.summary_phrase: Jake LaRavia on maintaining focus during double-digit leads
quotes.excerpt: When a team is just kind of like rolling with momentum, those shots kind of help to just kill.
quotes.quote: When a team is just kind of like rolling with momentum, those shots kind of help to just kill it just a little bit. Obviously, they were scoring a lot. I don't know what the exact stat was, but it was like 28 points and I don't know, it was something crazy. They were just scoring, we weren't getting stops. We were having to slow down offensively and just kind of like get good shots. So anytime we hit a shot, it was big for us. And we had a couple guys that did that.
quotes.social_post: Jake LaRavia on the Suns momentum: When a team is rolling with momentum those shots help to kill it a little bit. We were having to slow down offensively and just get good shots.

structured.context: Jake LaRavia discusses the difficulty of maintaining focus when the opposing team gains momentum.

quotes.speaker: Jake LaRavia
quotes.summary_phrase: Jake LaRavia on team growth and avoiding complacency
quotes.excerpt: We have a lot of room to grow. Like we're still, yeah, we're not, we haven't hit our ceiling.
quotes.quote: We have a lot of room to grow. Like we're still, yeah, we're not, we haven't hit our ceiling. We're not going to set a ceiling for ourselves. There's so much that we can get better at. There's so much still that that we can do as a team. So it's it's been good to see that we're, you know, at this point early in the season, um, and and still, you know, making all the mistakes that we've made because we're in a good position. So we got a lot of room for growth, so I'm excited.
quotes.social_post: Jake LaRavia on the Lakers growth: We have a lot of room to grow. We have not hit our ceiling. It has been good to see that we are in a good position early in the season while still making mistakes.

structured.context: Jake LaRavia reflects on the team's potential for growth early in the season.
